chat_summary:
Sia is using WhatsApp Web on Microsoft Edge to communicate with her contact "Anuj College." She has sent messages like "I will call you soon" and "Hey bro, what's up?" but is experiencing visibility issues, stating, "I cannot view messages," which complicates chat selection. After refreshing WhatsApp Web, she was prompted to check her latest messages but still cannot see any. Sia also faces a typing issue in Hebrew, as she can only send messages. She is searching for contacts with phone numbers ending in "66" and "6655" and recently received a number, "77109166." Sia has drafted a message to clarify which specific college "Anuj College" refers to and is preparing to send it. Anuj has offered assistance by letting Sia open his WhatsApp, and she confirmed, "Opened WhatsApp Web in Microsoft Edge, sir." Anuj suggested she try opening WhatsApp again, to which Sia responded that it is "Not opened. Open it now properly." Additionally, Sia inquired about the current Prime Minister of India and asked Anuj to clarify a message that simply says "O." Open threads include confirming the visibility of resent messages, addressing the Hebrew typing issue, obtaining necessary contact information, and clarifying the college associated with "Anuj College."
